notes: «سمعت ابن أبي مليكة» makes him the link; he narrates the scene ("حضرت") in his own voice
«فذكرت ذلك لعائشة فقالت» is asked-and-answers: Aisha is the last link, the one whose words carry the Prophet's saying
Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Umar and Suhayb speak inside the scene; Ibn Umar's «سمعت رسول الله» is a quotation inside it, not a route written here (rule 6 applies only to the transmitter of the saying)
